subproblem.title: Integral Lipschitz parametrization of a compactly supported integer multiplicity current
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsCompact X.support → ∃ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R.Represents X ∧ R.carrier ⊆ X.support ∧ R.measure univ ≠ ∞ ∧ ∃ (G : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)) (w : ℕ → Euclid n → ℤ) (c : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ), (∀ i, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (G i)) ∧ (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (w i)) ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (c i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ u ∈ A i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (G i) u) ∧ (∀ i, G i '' A i ⊆ X.support) ∧ (∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun u => (w i u : ℝ)) (A i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ u ∈ A i, 0 ≤ c i u ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |α (fun a => fderiv ℝ (G i) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))| ≤ c i u * covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ∑' i, ∫⁻ u in A i, ENNReal.ofReal (|(w i u : ℝ)| * c i u) ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ γ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, HasSum (fun i => ∫ u in A i, (w i u : ℝ) * (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (G i u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ (G i) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) (X γ)
proof_key_steps: Accepted dimred_mbl_dt_lpip_normalized_rep (with VO, MR, IMC) gives R representing X with R.carrier ⊆ spt X.
R.measure univ = ∫⁻_M θ = ∫⁻_{M ∩ spt X} θ < ∞ by locallyIntegrable_mult on the compact spt X.

Accepted dimred_mbl_dt_lpip_piece_representation (with B1, GB, IMC) gives Lipschitz pieces (G_i, A_i, w_i, c_i) with G_i(A_i) ⊆ R.carrier ⊆ spt X, Σ∫|w_i|c_i ≤ μ_R(ℝ^P), and HasSum to R.action η for continuous compactly supported η.
Test forms are continuous with compact support, and R.action γ = X(γ), so the HasSum holds with limit X(γ).
